title: Open forum clinics and the business of music
summary: Clinic sessions are an open forum, including band management and booking, countering the myth of overnight success.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Do you talk about other roles or functions in the music industry they could get into?
If they -- well, it's an open forum.

In other words, they can ask of me and I practice my answers by simply saying that I've been out there a long time, and there isn't hardly anything that you could ask me that would embarrass me or scare me. And my conscience is reasonably clear, so go, and no holds barred, because I don't give a damn.
Do they ask you about things related to the business aspects of music?
In one session this summer we had Ernie come over to do a thing on band management.
It seems to me there's a tremendous need for that.

No, because everything the kids read about it, and I'm not necessarily speaking of jazz, but the current music scene is that overnight, so-and-so, the latest punk group, they just started to talk it over, and now they're a hit.
Yeah, and it's not that way.
